_help: Section headings are pulled automatically (Berean Standard Bible headings, which the Majority Standard Bible shares).
Override any of them here, then run: node scripts/build-data.js
Key = BOOK CHAPTER:VERSE using the book codes in data/nt.json (MAT MRK LUK JHN ACT ROM 1CO 2CO GAL EPH PHP COL 1TH 2TH 1TI 2TI TIT PHM HEB JAS 1PE 2PE 1JN 2JN 3JN JUD REV).
A string sets or renames the heading that starts a section at that verse (it can also add a new section).
null removes the section break at that verse, so it joins the section before it.
Example: "MRK 4:1": "The Parable of the Sower"   or   "MRK 4:21": null
